topics.description: The Minnesota House of Representatives recently deadlocked on an impeachment resolution against Governor Walz and another official. This development has significant implications for the state's political landscape.
topics.reason: Impeachment proceedings are a rare and serious event in state politics.

topics.description: The FBI has been actively involved in several investigations, including searches at Lancaster City Hall and a student charged with a social media threat at Gaylesville School. These actions indicate a heightened focus on law enforcement and public safety.
topics.reason: FBI involvement suggests potential federal crimes or threats.
